title: dracocephalum imberbe var. laniflorum
intro: Dracocephalum imberbe var. laniflorum, commonly known as the Tibetan blue poppy or fragrant dragon flower, is a plant species in the mint family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dracocephalum imberbe var. laniflorum include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, although specific bioactive constituents are not extensively documented.
